English translation from the Modern Amharic of the EOTC Bible (nehemiah-osc.org) by Claude (Anthropic) with collaborator, May 2026. Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication (archive.org/details/three-books-of-meqabyan-cc0-translation). Apparatus integrates Josef Horovitz, 'Das äthiopische Maccabäerbuch,' Zeitschrift für Assyriologie XIX (1905), pp. 194-233 — PD primary scholarly study. 64-citation third-pass audit verdict matrix; 57 verified, 4 errors corrected, 3 interpretive readings flagged, 7 newly discovered parallels added. Dating widened to Aksumite-to-Solomonic Ethiopian Christian range (4th-14th c. CE); precise composition date undetermined in current scholarship per Horovitz 1905 non-commitment. Three books: 1 Mq 36 chapters (Maqabis-of-Benjamin martyrology vs Ṣiruṣaydan); 2 Mq 21 chapters (Maqabis-of-Moab conversion + sons' martyrdom + Ṣiruṣaydan's death); 3 Mq 10 chapters (homiletic + angelological dialogue + Satan-refused-Adam tradition + resurrection-doctrine).

OPENS Ch 24 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR: divine-justice theme. The chapter likely develops divine-justice as the integrating-anchor for the chapter's prophetic-confrontation arc. The divine-justice theme parallels: PSALM 9:7-8 + 11:7 + 96:13 + 98:9 (God-judges-the-world-with-righteousness); DEUTERONOMY 32:4 ('he is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he'); ROMANS 2:1-11 (Pauline-divine-impartiality at judgment); 2 THESSALONIANS 1:5-10 (the righteous-judgment of God at parousia); REVELATION 16:5-7 (thou-art-righteous-O-Lord acclamations at judgment-pouring); WISDOM 12:12-22 (the philosophical-treatment of divine-justice). Patristic-tradition: AUGUSTINE City of God 19-22 (the most-extended treatment of divine-justice + the two-cities eschatology); GREGORY THE GREAT Moralia in Iob (the foundational Latin Job-commentary on divine-justice-and-Job's-suffering). Tewahedo theological tradition preserves divine-justice as the integrating-anchor for the trilogy's anti-Sebelyanos/Ṣiruṣaydan polemic-architecture.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of FALSE-PROPHET / TRUE-PROPHET DISTINCTION theme. The true-vs-false-prophet distinction parallels: DEUTERONOMY 18:15-22 (the canonical criterion — prophecies that come to pass vs do not); JEREMIAH 28:1-17 (Jeremiah vs Hananiah — the true-vs-false-prophet confrontation); EZEKIEL 13 + 14:9-11 (false-prophets-and-prophets-of-presumption); 1 KINGS 22:5-28 (Micaiah vs the 400 prophets); MATTHEW 7:15-23 ('beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing'); 1 JOHN 4:1 ('try the spirits whether they are of God'); 2 PETER 2:1-3 (false-prophets-among-you). Patristic-tradition: TERTULLIAN De Praescriptione Haereticorum (the criterion-of-apostolic-rule); IRENAEUS Adversus Haereses 3 (the criterion-of-tradition); ATHANASIUS Discourses Against the Arians I-III (the criterion-of-orthodox-doctrine — γ.4.9 Athanasian arc-anchor). Tewahedo theological tradition preserves the true-vs-false-prophet distinction as part of the Tewahedo Hayyamanot (confessional-faith) preservation-criterion.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of DIVINE-VINDICATION-AT-CHAPTER-CLOSE. The divine-vindication theme parallels: PSALM 94:1-23 (the vengeance-of-God psalm); PSALM 37:7-9 (the righteous-shall-inherit-the-earth); HABAKKUK 2:2-4 (the just-shall-live-by-faith); 2 THESSALONIANS 1:6-7 (it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation); REVELATION 19:1-5 (alleluia + the smoke-of-Babylon's-judgment); JOB 19:25-27 (I know that my redeemer liveth + I shall see God for myself). Tewahedo eschatological tradition preserves divine-vindication as the corollary-of-divine-justice (24:1 anchor). The chapter likely closes with the integrating-pivot: divine-justice-and-vindication ground the trilogy's confidence-in-faithfulness-under-imperial-tyranny.
